messages:
maria: Quick idea  run a short webinar focused on our new inference TCO benchmarks + how teams can use them in launch comms. Short, punchy, aimed at PMs + engineering. Thoughts?
alex: love it. We can lead with a 3-metric narrative: cost/unit, latency SLO, and failure-mode costs. Suggest 30m talk + 15m Q&A.
sam: Creative can make a one-slide benchmark explainer and a 15s social clip. Need hero stat and headshots by Wed.
nina: I can share the customer story about switching routing policies that moved their TCO needle. 5-min case study.
lee: Ops note: recording studio free 2026-11-03 or 11-10. Which works for rehearsals? calendar-bot: Tentative slot added -> https://cal.example.com/event/1955550001
emily: Sales request  add a form checkbox "interested in benchmark review" so we can route leads and request a short qualification note.
maria: Run-of-show proposal:
00:00-00:03 - Welcome + why benchmarks matter (maria)
00:03-00:12 - Benchmark methodology & headline findings (alex)
00:12-00:17 - Customer TCO case study (nina)
00:17-00:25 - How to use benchmarks in launch docs + messaging (sam + emily)
00:25-00:30 - Top action checklist + CTAs (all)
00:30-00:45 - Live Q&A
Keep it tight; focus on actionable takeaways.
alex: I will prepare a short methodology slide and two bench graphs (cost per 1k tokens; tail latency percentiles).
sam: Social A/B test for headline: A) "Real inference costs, explained" B) "How we measured inference TCO". We'll test both.
nina: I'll draft a 60-80 word abstract + 3 takeaways by Fri COB.
lee: Locking studio for 11-10 11:00 PT unless anyone objects. calendar-bot: Event updated -> Tue 2026-11-10 11:00 PT
emily: We'll route registrants who check "benchmark review" to Sales queue D. Also add a hidden field for current infra (hosted/dedicated/private).
maria: Action items: Alex -> bench slides + graphs; Nina -> abstract + case; Sam -> hero visual + social A/B copy; Emily -> reg form fields & lead routing; Lee -> book rehearsal invites. Drop assets into the doc by Wed 11/3.
alex: Demo note  we'll pre-record the heavy graphs to avoid live data fetch flaps.
sam: I'll prepare two social variants and a short explainer GIF.
maria: Locking topic: "Benchmarking inference TCO: actionable metrics for launches". If no objections by EOD, I'll spin up the landing page and promo calendar. Thanks!
